_readme: S357 SkyCanopy, 2026-10-10, second curriQunet read. The first (rccd_curriqunet_outline, run 38075620248) found the catalog's own data calls: _getNavigation?id=124&parentId=6323 lists all 229 entries of Riverside City's Degrees and Certificates Index (each a title naming its awards and local codes, an outline id and an alias), and _getPage?catalogId=124&id=<id> returns one outline node's page as JSON. This read loads the Acting entry (outline 5878) two ways: its view with "network": true, to see whether the requirements come from _getPage or a further call, and the _getPage JSON itself, to see how the requirements are written in it. Two page loads, no model call.

questions.page_source: Which call delivers a program's requirements, and whether one call holds the whole of them.
questions.page_shape: How the requirements are written in that call: HTML blocks, course rows, units, choose-N wording.
